llm_summary_material: Process perishable input immediately — coffee cherries must be depulped and fermented within hours of picking or they spoil.

Choose the process by risk appetite — washed highlights acidity and floral notes, natural gives fruity wine-like flavours but risks off-flavours when drying is uneven, and honey sits between the two by retention of mucilage.
Treat cost curves as expiring data — battery packs fell from ~$1,100/kWh in 2010 to under $140/kWh in 2023, so price assumptions must be re-verified each procurement cycle rather than reused.
Design for regional standards fragmentation — CCS dominates Europe and North America, GB/T China, CHAdeMO Japan, so no single charging spec is globally deployable.
Know the ceiling before optimising — the Betz limit caps any wind turbine at 59.3% efficiency, and real machines only reach 45–50%.

Site selection dominates every other wind decision — available power grows with the cube of wind speed (doubling average speed ≈ 8× yield), and turbines only run between ~3 m/s cut-in and ~25 m/s cut-out.
Schedule hard cutovers with全网 coordination — ARPANET's TCP/IP flag day on 1 Jan 1983 replaced NCP in one step, and DNS in 1983 replaced a single hosts file to make naming scale.

Compare against the correct baseline — field photosynthesis converts only ~3% of light into biomass, against ~10% solar-to-fuel in a 2022 artificial device, so efficiency claims are meaningless without the reference system.
